title: Going to Los Angeles in 1941 and the Army in 1943
summary: Verrett was in California in 1941, then was called into the Army in 1943 and returned to New Orleans.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Have you been out to Los Angeles again since the war, or California since the war?

Well, I was there in 58. 58. Yeah, I've been out there 58. See, during 1940, that's when I went 41 out there. I worked out with all the four shit, but then I went on the base, you know, because they'd stay out of the Army. But in 43, they called me in the Army. Anyways, I said, I went in the Army anyway. So I come down here, and I pass my exam here, bring my wife home, and went to take my service here.
